item.simplyswords.arcanethystsworditem.t: Chance on hit to levitate your target.
For a short duration, lift nearby medium-sized enemies with arcane force, then slam them into the ground.
item.simplyswords.bloodwakesworditem.too: Hits inflict Bleed. Striking an enemy at maximum Bleed consumes it in a blood burst and grants Blood Frenzy.
The burst damages nearby enemies and inflicts Bleed around the target.
Consume all Blood Frenzy to invoke one of five blood rites.
More Frenzy invokes stronger rites: wake, scream, spectral blades, blood flies, and the Red Tide.
Blood bursts and blood waves stain the ground, slowing enemies and healing you while you stand in the blood.
Summon a Brimstone Claymore above the target that pulses area damage before plunging into the ground.
item.simplyswords.caelestissworditem.too: Tear open a breach into another dimension, summoning corrupted creatures that fight for you.
The breach lasts %1$ds and expands to a %2$d block radius.
It collapses over its final %1$ds, pulling the summons back to their dimension. Each breach has a %2$d%% chance to release an Unbound creature that hunts you.
item.simplyswords.chompolotlsworditem.to: Axolotls attack nearby enemies, and can be perched on your shoulders to provide area buffs.
item.simplyswords.dawnquiversworditem.to: A lesser bow periodically fires at the most distant enemy you can see, and has a %d%% chance to grant Dawn Chorus.
Store up to %d Chorus on this weapon.
Hold to draw a great bow of light, firing an arrow based on your release timing and Dawn Chorus charges.
Dawn Volley - Spend 1 Chorus to loose a second arrow. %ss CD.
Sunlance - Spend 2 Chorus to pierce up to four enemies. %ss CD.
Seraphic Chorus - Spend 3 Chorus to summon three converging bows. %ss CD.
item.simplyswords.devourerclaymoreitem.t: Deflecting an attack opens an abyssal maw beneath the attacker, damaging nearby enemies and dragging them inward.
The mass spreads Gloam as it lashes up to %d nearby enemies, drags them into its core, and feeds upon them.
The mass grows as it feeds, before collapsing and releasing its captives after %.1f seconds.
A deflection near your Devouring Mass feeds it and redirects the drag toward its core.
Launch an abyssal seed that blooms into a floating, living mass at the targeted location.
Targets struck by Shadow Rend suffer a Corrupted Wound for %ss.
Striking a wounded target with Dreadwhisper guarantees a critical hit and ruptures the wound.
Become a wall of dark energy, surge through enemies, and leave Gloam in your wake.
Each enemy in the path takes a weapon hit, suffers a Corrupted Wound, and heals you for %s%% of the health removed.
item.simplyswords.emberlashsworditem.too: Attacking enemies inflicted with Smouldering causes you to deal an additional %d damage per stack.
Evade backwards while cauterising your wounds, healing for %d%% of Max HP.
item.simplyswords.enigmasworditem.toolti: While you are near to your twister, gain Haste.
Summon a twister that chases down nearby enemies, dealing increased damage the longer an enemy remains trapped within.
item.simplyswords.flamewindsworditem.too: When a flame seed detonates, gain Haste.
Plant a seed of flame within the nearest enemy, dealing damage over time.
Upon expiring, the seed detonates, dealing area damage and spreading the effect to nearby enemies.
item.simplyswords.frostfallsworditem.too: Throw Frostfall forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
After landing, Frostfall pulses 5 times, damaging, slowing,  and pulling enemies.
Swing toward an enemy 3–12 blocks away to summon an airborne shadow clone that hurls an explosive spear at the target.
Rise into the air and command shadow clones to bombard the targeted area with Gloam spears.
item.simplyswords.harbingersworditem.too: Chance on hit to inflict weakness.
Summons an Abyssal Battle Standard that pulls, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting haste to friendly players within its vicinity.
item.simplyswords.hiveheartsworditem.too: Release an angry bee on hit that stings your target before disappearing.
This effect can only occur once every %ds.
Release a swarm of tiny bees to harass nearby enemies, slowing and damaging them repeatedly.
item.simplyswords.icewhispersworditem.to: While wielded, gain a frost aura that deals damage and slows enemies within %d blocks.
Ice comets crash down around you for a duration, dealing area damage where they land.
item.simplyswords.ionbound_stormscaleswo: Periodically generate up to 3 Ion Cubes while wielded.
When receiving a single large hit of damage, consume an ion cube to negate the damage and surround yourself with a protective field for 2 seconds.
Consume a cube to create an ion corridor that pushes enemies inward before slamming shut.
Activate again within 1 second of the slam to consume another cube and channel a steerable energy beam for 3 seconds, repeatedly damaging and paralysing enemies for 5 seconds.
Your movement and aim are greatly slowed while channelling the beam.
item.simplyswords.livyatansworditem.tool: Throw Livyatan forward. Airtime and angle affect impact damage.
On return, Livyatan creates a wave that pulls enemies, and has a chance to strike them with lightning.
Has innate Loyalty III. Weapon swings release a damaging wave.
item.simplyswords.magiblade.event: Your Decaying Relic seems to be quivering
item.simplyswords.magiblade.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems gravitated to the block beneath you
item.simplyswords.magibladesworditem.too: The Magiblade occasionally detects and repels approaching enemies.
After charging, summon a Warden head that orbits you for %s seconds and periodically fires sonic waves at nearby enemies. Using the ability again refreshes its duration.
item.simplyswords.magiscythesworditem.to: Attacking enemies while Magistorm is active grants a chance to repair an equipped item.
A localised magical storm manifests above you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
Each time the storm strikes, it has a chance to refresh its duration and increases its severity.
item.simplyswords.magispear.event: Your Decaying Relic seems to have been influenced by something
item.simplyswords.magispear.event2: Your Decaying Relic seems to be reacting to the darkness
item.simplyswords.magispearsworditem.too: Chance on hit to deal additional magic damage.
Launch the Magispear skyward, calling down a rain of magic spears that damage enemies.
When the spear rain ends, leap to the target area to deliver a final slam attack.
item.simplyswords.ribboncleaversworditem: Wielding Ribboncleaver causes you to move 5% slower, but take 15% less damage.
Dash forward, shrugging off the next few incoming hits, gaining knockback resistance, and causing your next attack to deal +95% damage to a single target.
item.simplyswords.riftmanesworditem.tool: Chance on swing to tear open a rift and loose a single spectral charger at a distant foe.
Split the air into a rank of spectral chargers that surge forward, goring and scattering everything in their path.
Using the ability while sprinting causes you to mount the central charger.
item.simplyswords.soulpyresworditem.tool: Cause the landscape around you to shift into the nether. Slaying enemies within this malformed landscape causes it to grow larger.
While active, you gain knockback resistance and take 50% reduced damage.
Defeated enemies grant you souls, which are periodically fired as homing projectiles.
item.simplyswords.soulstalkersworditem.t: Abyssal tendrils periodically emerge from your back and pierce nearby enemies.
Rise upon six abyssal limbs to stride across the terrain. Charge jump to perform a directional leap.
While in-use, footsteps spread Gloam and damage nearby enemies, while weapon swings release shadow cleaves.
On hit, spend a Storm Charge to fire chain lightning between nearby enemies.
Focus energy to a single point of your blade, becoming briefly immune to incoming damage.
Perfectly timing this ability triggers a counterattack and grants Storm Charges.
item.simplyswords.stormscalesworditem.to: While you have a Stormscale planted in the ground, your melee attacks trigger area damage around it.
Plant a spectral glaive at the targeted location and tether it to you.
Each melee attack you perform increases its pulse damage and radius by 1%, stacking up to 80%.
item.simplyswords.sunfiresworditem.toolt: Chance on hit to regenerate health.
Summons a Righteous Battle Standard that ignites, damages, and slows enemies whilst periodically granting strength and health to friendly players within its vicinity.
item.simplyswords.tempestsworditem.toolt: Your attacks attach elemental energy to the target, causing damage over time and element specific debuffs.
Return all nearby elements to yourself, forming a vortex of elemental energy around you, damaging nearby enemies and growing in size.
Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Charge your weapon, becoming immune to damage.
Once charged, dash through enemies and release chain lightning for each instance of damage you would have received while charging.
item.simplyswords.watchersworditem.claym: A stream of bats repeatedly tear into the enemy before delivering a final attack based on the targets missing health.
At maximum Dread, enemies left below %d%% health are executed.
Killing the target resets the cooldown.
item.simplyswords.waxweaversworditem.too: Attacking ignited enemies grants you Strength and Haste.
Encase an enemy in wax, preventing it from moving or attacking, and causing nearby enemies to attack it.
When you would die, you are instead imbued with magic wax, healing you to full and granting resistance for a short time.
The wax prison detonates when it expires or its victim dies.
This effect can only occur once every %ds. Mainhand only.
item.simplyswords.whisperwindsworditem.t: Chance on hit to refresh ability cooldown.
Perform a swift forward dash, gaining resistance and absorption. Enemies caught in the path take damage after a short delay.
item.simplyswords.wickpiercersworditem.t: Throw Wickpiercer, gaining frenzy stacks that grant attackspeed and allow you
item.simplyswords.wraithfangsworditem.to: Throw Wraithfang and leap towards its position, briefly becoming immune to damage.
item.simplyswords.wraithmawsworditem.too: When collected, spectral cutlasses float above you, seeking targets when you swing your weapon.
Send a barrage of spectral cutlasses that leave Gloam where they land.

research.mythsandlegends.molten_fist.com: The power sealed within the Molten Fist is now understood. The wrath of Abaddon answers my call.
research.mythsandlegends.molten_fist.pro: The Abaddon Core still burns with an unnatural force. Its energy refuses to fade, even after being separated from its original host.
The scorched remains begin to merge with the core. This weapon was not forged... it was awakened.

research.mythsandlegends.noctifer_tenebr: The knowledge of Noctifer Tenebris is already mine.
The refined Tenebrite resonates with the Bound Soul Ingots. There is power hidden within this alloy.
The weapon seems to crave darkness, almost as if it were alive.
Its true name reveals itself... Noctifer Tenebris. A relic forged for those who embrace the Umbral.
The secrets behind Noctifer Tenebris have been uncovered.
Ancient manuscripts speak of a blade that commands the darkness itself. Perhaps they were not mere legends.
